name: finance_story (learned from reference Short T45WLa7nTjw)

pacing.note: Reference has 19 cuts in 54 s, no silences >0.4 s. Jump-cut every breath.

camera.single_source_fallback: simulate second angle with crop-zoom + horizontal offset on every cut

captions.font: bold geometric sans (Inter/SF Pro Bold; Windows fallback Segoe UI Bold)
captions.animation: hard cut in, no pop (clean documentary style)

section_headers.trigger: list points (first/second/last thing) and the takeaway

accent_word.font: serif bold italic (Playfair/DM Serif; fallback Georgia Bold Italic)

section_headers.build: word-by-word, accent word arrives last on its own line, offset right

icon_badges.trigger: concrete nouns being listed (rooms, items, options)
icon_badges.style: dark translucent circle (#000 @55%), 1.5px white ring @60%, white flat line icon inside
icon_badges.layout: badges arranged on a thin connecting circle (r≈210 px) below the caption
icon_badges.animation: each badge pops in (scale 0.6->1.0, 0.2 s, ease-out) when its word is spoken; connector line draws on

corner_icons.style: same badge, 100 px, left/right of caption

audio.voice: loudness-normalised to about -14 LUFS, tight jump cuts
audio.music: none confirmed from analysis; if added, keep a soft bed 18-20 dB under the voice
audio.sfx: optional soft whoosh on section headers

structure: 0-3 s: hook = personal number/stake shown as big stat
body: numbered points, each opened by a section header with a serif accent word
concrete details illustrated with icon badges
last 3 s: payoff number as big stat, no outro/CTA card
